title: Split the checks job by family, and rebalance the macOS guard shards
why: Retrospective CI audit 14:12 CST Nov 12, batch 103 green run 43234925158: 55.0 min wall; checks is 35.1 min over 161 serial steps with no single suite dominating; macOS guard shard 1/2 alone takes 19.1 min. MERGED 03:18 CST Nov 14: PR #3376 (ci-split-checks-v2, replaces #2980; the Linux `checks` job split into checks, checks-hooks and checks-rest) merged at 03:15:57 CST (09:15:57 UTC, REST merged=true, merged_by shivinate7; head c0476cab1241). Runner 10's main sha 4db2a9cf3c10 is unchecked by triage. Real wall times of the three new jobs are unmeasured until main's run after the merge; read them from that run (the PR body projected checks 18.5, checks-hooks 10.5, checks-rest 11.6 min each plus about 1 min setup).
note: R55 express (owner 14:05 CST Nov 12). Split checks by family, as the Windows split does; rebalance the macOS guard shards. Estimate: the run ends near 30 min (unmeasured). Side notes from the audit: impeccable-sync.yml:12 has top-level contents: write; playwright-setup steps at checks.yml:732, 768, 804, 844 have no cap of their own; no setup-python or npm cache (0.5-1.1 min per job). Lane started 14:22 CST Nov 12. Lane 14:39 CST Nov 12: may the macOS split use a 4th macOS job? Measured (run 43234925158): macOS guard suite 2179 s, other macOS suites 1434 s; 3 guard shards in 3 jobs project about 20.7 min each (fails the under-20 done line); 4 guard jobs about 15.7 min. Triage answer 14:44 CST, from decision ci-job-caps line 79 (measured, not an owner ruling): keep 3 macOS jobs and ship the Linux split now (macOS about 19.5 min, meets the done line). A 4th job queued 379 s in run 41383013723, which eats most of the 5 min gain. Revisit 4 guard jobs when ci-batch-mac-runner moves batch macOS jobs to the owner's MacBook, where GitHub's macOS limit does not apply. R61 (owner 15:29 CST Nov 12): macOS runs once per batch on the batch PR, OS-tagged tests only; step ci-mac-once-per-batch. Coordinator 11:38 CST Nov 13: #2980 keeps the split of checks; step ci-split-checks-jobs folded in (owner 11:34 CST via runner 10, "the suites bend, not the wait"). Lane session_013NEJL2UPotZrZRQ9WLTshH adopts #2980; the earlier lane id on this step is replaced.
